subject: general
question: Which of the following satellites of India was renamed after Dr. Kalpana Chawla in February, 2003?
solution:
The correct answer is __**METSAT-1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Kalpana-1 is a meteorological satellite launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• It was originally named METSAT-1 and was later renamed to honor Kalpana Chawla, the first woman of Indian origin in space.</li&g
